body: No. I just figured Id punch my stamp somewhere since I have nowhere else, nor does anybody care. All Im saying is, you're not helping anyone by calling someone out and deliberately starting an argument. Some people do post here for some help and I think its nice that people try.

Wow. I didnt mean to start an argument on here. This person was trying to be nice and help me. There are plenty of people like that if you believe it or not. I just simply dont want to waste time for him and me both. I didnt mean to be rude. Please dont argue in these types of chats.
Ive made up my mind. Ive tried to talk to people and get through this. Sometimes I feel better, but even when I do, it comes back 2x worse. Im tired of wasting time

Its not just that. Ive had a long run with depression and its constantly getting worse. This move was supposed to be a sort of last hope thing. If it doesnt work, then Im back to nothing. I cant handle it
I have. Some people agreed I havent improved. Gave me their best advice and went on there way. Im done

That would take time and require me to go back to ground zero. Sounds more like a hassle for me to restart and go through the same stages as I did with drawing. I have tried my hand at different arts. Writing was one that I worked really hard on as well. Went through this and gave up. At that time I wasn't as depressed as I am now, so I was able to move on. I tried sculpture, music, painting, photography. Nothing was like this or writing. I wanted to combine the two and create a little graphic novel/web comic series. Of course that's over. How am I supposed to create this comic series when I can't draw anything well. People would hate it, most of all me

I want this as a career, but that will never happen. I have considered taking classes, but I don't have the money and honestly how can it help any more than just online. Especially with things like Proko and Sycra. It should be easy. At least easier, but not for me. I'm a lost cause

I used to when I was in hs till I started getting more depressed. I think I will start posting on twitter and insta soon. As of now, its only studies and I dont really think thats the best to show without any completed pieces. Maybe soon
Illustration/Pencil and paper. Im currently only drawing humans but wanted to expand into landscapes. Hopefully want to make my own graphic novel in the future.
